title: TS API
html:
For the complete documentation index, see llms.txt. Markdown versions of documentation pages are available by appending .md to page URLs; this page is available as Markdown.

TS API

ID generators

Six wrappers around the built-in idgen.Generator. They return the next free value for the corresponding entity; counters are restored from the DB on server start (MAX(id) + 1). Plugins that create an entity on the server side must take the ID via these helpers so it does not collide with existing DB records.

TsAgentGenID()  int64   // entity "agent",  table Agents.Id
TsTaskGenID()   int64   // entity "task",   table Tasks.TaskId
TsCredGenID()   int64   // entity "cred",   table Credentials.CredId
TsScreenGenID() int64   // entity "screen", table Screenshots.ScreenId
TsTargetGenID() int64   // entity "target", table Targets.TargetId
TsFileGenID()   int64   // entity "file",   table Downloads.FileId

Agent Functions

TsAgentIsExists

Checks if an agent exists by ID.

TsAgentIsExists(agentId int64) bool

Returns: bool — true if agent exists

TsAgentGetById

Reads one in-memory session. The second result is false when the id is unknown or the agent was removed.

TsAgentGetById(agentId int64) (AgentData, bool)

TsAgentIdByUID

Linear search for an agent by UID (optional identifier filled by the listener/agent plugin, not overlapping with agentId). 

TsAgentIdByUID(uid []byte) (int64, bool)

Returns: the found agentId and true; (0, false) if no agent has this UID or uid is empty.

TsAgentList

JSON array of every in-memory session (AgentData as stored, including the session key). An empty server marshals as null, not [].

TsAgentList() (string, error)

TsAgentCatalog

JSON array of registered agent types, sorted by name. Each item is {name, listeners, axs}. axs is the agent AxScript and is omitted when empty.

TsAgentCatalog() (string, error)

TsAgentCreate

Creates a new agent on first connection.

TsAgentCreate(agentCrc string, agentUid []byte, beat []byte, listenerName string, ExternalIP string, Async bool) (adaptix.AgentData, error)
ParameterTypeDescription
agentCrcstringCRC/watermark of the agent type
agentUid[]byteUnique agent UID (agentId is generated server-side)
beat[]byteInitial data from agent (heartbeat)
listenerNamestringListener name
ExternalIPstringAgent's external IP
AsyncboolAsynchronous mode

Returns: adaptix.AgentData, error

Events:

  • agent.new (Pre/Post hooks)

TsAgentProcessData

Processes data received from an agent.

TsAgentProcessData(agentId int64, bodyData []byte) error
ParameterTypeDescription
agentIdint64Agent ID
bodyData[]byteData from agent

Events: agent.activate (post only), and only when Mark was "Inactive". The mark is cleared, the row is saved, then the post hook runs.

TsAgentUpdateData

Updates agent data (sleep, jitter, killdate, workingtime).

TsAgentUpdateData(newAgentData adaptix.AgentData) error

TsAgentUpdateDataPartial

Partial update of agent data. updateData is any struct/map that JSON-marshals to an object with keys from the table below; only present fields are applied.

TsAgentUpdateDataPartial(agentId int64, updateData interface{}) error

Supported fields (JSON key → AgentData field):

JSON keyAgentData fieldType
internal_ipInternalIPstring
external_ipExternalIPstring
gmt_offsetGmtOffsetint
acpACPint
oemcpOemCPint
pidPidstring
tidTidstring
archArchstring
elevatedElevatedbool
processProcessstring
osOsint
os_descOsDescstring
domainDomainstring
computerComputerstring
usernameUsernamestring
impersonatedImpersonatedstring
tagsTagsstring
markMarkstring
colorColorstring ("bg-fg" hex, RGB-validated)
listenerListenerstring
a_session_keySessionKeystring (stored as []byte; not emitted in TYPE_AGENT_UPDATE)
custom_dataCustomDatastring (stored as []byte; not emitted in TYPE_AGENT_UPDATE)
sleepSleepuint
jitterJitteruint
working_timeWorkingTimeint (packed: (startH<<24)|(startM<<16)|(endH<<8)|endM)
kill_dateKillDateint (unix seconds)

Notes:

  • Changing Mark is silently ignored if the current mark is already "Terminated" (terminal state).
  • Setting Mark = "Disconnect" also updates LastTick to the current time.
  • Color accepts "<bg>-<fg>" hex ("#1e3050-#ffffff"); each half is checked as a valid RGB, and an empty half keeps the previous value.
  • Empty updateData (no recognized fields) is a no-op: the function returns nil, nothing is written to the DB, no sync packet is sent.
  • Fields not listed are ignored. Crc, Id, UID, Name, CreateTime, Async, and TargetId cannot be modified through this API. LastTick changes only as a side effect of Mark = "Disconnect", or through TsAgentSetTick. Active is a runtime flag on the Agent struct, not part of AgentData.

Typical call from a plugin (for example inside OnDispatch for sleep):

ts.TsAgentUpdateDataPartial(agentId, struct {
    Sleep  *uint `json:"sleep"`
    Jitter *uint `json:"jitter"`
}{Sleep: &newSleep, Jitter: &newJitter})

TsAgentTerminate

Terminates an agent.

TsAgentTerminate(agentId int64, terminateTaskId int64) error

Actions performed:

  1. Cancels all active downloads
  2. Stops all tunnels
  3. Closes terminals
  4. Clears task queues
  5. Removes pivot links

Events:

  • agent.terminate (Pre/Post hooks)

TsAgentSetTick

Updates the agent's last response time.

TsAgentSetTick(agentId int64, listenerName string) error

TsAgentConsoleOutput

Outputs a message to the agent console.

TsAgentConsoleOutput(agentId int64, client string, messageType int, message string, clearText string, store bool)
ParameterTypeDescription
agentIdint64Agent ID
clientstringInitiator operator name (used for filtering in non-team mode)
messageTypeintMessage type (5=INFO, 6=ERROR, 7=SUCCESS)
messagestringMessage header
clearTextstringMessage text
storeboolSave to the DB

TsAgentBuildExecute

Runs an external command during agent build, redirecting output to the build WebSocket channel.

TsAgentBuildExecute(builderId string, workingDir string, env []string, program string, args ...string) error
ParameterTypeDescription
builderIdstringBuilder ID (empty string for synchronous execution)
workingDirstringWorking directory for the command
programstringExecutable
args...stringCommand-line arguments

Note: If builderId is empty, the command runs synchronously without output to the WebSocket. Otherwise stdout/stderr are redirected to the build channel.

TsAgentBuildLog

Sends a log message to the agent's WebSocket build channel.

TsAgentBuildLog(builderId string, status int, message string) error
ParameterTypeDescription
builderIdstringBuilder ID
statusintStatus: BUILD_LOG_NONE=0, INFO=1, ERROR=2, SUCCESS=3
messagestringMessage text

TsAgentEncryptData / TsAgentDecryptData

Session-key encrypt and decrypt. Both return an error if the agent has been removed.

TsAgentEncryptData(agentId int64, data []byte) ([]byte, error)
TsAgentDecryptData(agentId int64, data []byte) ([]byte, error)

TsSetAgentDeliveryFunc / TsRemoveAgentDeliveryFunc / TsGetAgentDeliveryFunc

Per-agent push callback. TsTaskCreate calls it in a goroutine so a listener can deliver a task without waiting for the next poll. DeliveryFunc is func(agentId int64, taskData TaskData) error.

TsSetAgentDeliveryFunc(AgentId int64, fn DeliveryFunc)
TsRemoveAgentDeliveryFunc(AgentId int64)
TsGetAgentDeliveryFunc(AgentId int64) DeliveryFunc

TsAgentGetHosted* Functions

Retrieve tasks for sending to an agent. All functions pack tasks while respecting a size limit. They do not write to the agent console — dequeue is not a send. The task queue (HostedQueue) is a safe.PriorityQueue with FIFO inside each priority level; Pop() returns the highest-priority item first.

StatTasks is counted after OnDispatch. Each known task type has its own {Count, Bytes} (Task, Job, Browser, Tunnel, Proxy, Local, Other). Helpers: stats.Commands() (TASK+JOB), stats.Total(), stats.Of(taskType), stat.SizeString().

TsAgentGetHostedAll

Gets all available tasks: regular tasks, tunnel tasks, tunnel data, and pivot tasks.

TsAgentGetHostedAll(agentId int64, maxDataSize int) ([]byte, StatTasks, error)
ParameterTypeDescription
agentIdint64Agent ID
maxDataSizeintMaximum data size (bytes)

Returns: Packed bytes, operator-visible note, error.

A nested TsAgentGetHostedAll for a child should not write a console line for that child.

TsAgentGetHostedTasks

Gets hosted tasks without pivot. maxCount <= 0 means unlimited.

TsAgentGetHostedTasks(agentId int64, maxCount int, maxDataSize int) ([]byte, StatTasks, error)
ParameterTypeDescription
agentIdint64Agent ID
maxCountintMax tasks, or <= 0 for unlimited
maxDataSizeintMax data size in bytes

The teamserver does not write a console line. After a successful send the listener formats its own text from StatTasks and the bytes it actually wrote (FormatByteSize(len(wire))). stats.Packed is size after PackTasks, before listener wrapping.

Framed transports: the listener prints with adaptix.NoteFrameSent / NoteFrameRecv after TsFrameGetChunk or TsFrameGetChunkSticky, or after a completed TsFramePut, TsFramePutDecoded, or TsFramePutStream. TsFrameTakeStatTasks and TsFrameTakeStatRecv fire once per blob.

TsAgentBuildEmptyTasks

Packs an empty task blob with the agent session key. 

TsAgentBuildEmptyTasks(agentId int64) ([]byte, error)

Task Functions

TsTaskRunningExists

Checks if a task is running.

TsTaskRunningExists(agentId int64, taskId int64) bool

TsTaskCreate

Creates a new task.

TsTaskCreate(agentId int64, cmdline string, client string, taskData adaptix.TaskData)

A task created with taskData.Completed = true (a command that finished on the server) does not enter the HostedQueue. It is finalized immediately: task.complete post hook and a sync broadcast.

Events:

  • task.create (Pre/Post hooks)

TsTaskUpdate

Updates the task with execution results.

TsTaskUpdate(agentId int64, updateData adaptix.TaskData)

Events:

  • task.complete (post only) when this update finalizes the task (Completed on a synced task or job). An update that only parks the task for a client hook does not emit it. Cancel goes through TsTaskCancel and does not emit task.complete.
  • task.update_job (post only) on every update of a TASK_TYPE_JOB task, before that job is finalized. task.start is declared and is not emitted.

TsTaskCancel

Cancels a task — both one still queued and one already dispatched to the agent.

TsTaskCancel(agentId int64, taskId int64) error
ParameterTypeDescription
agentIdint64Agent ID
taskIdint64Task ID
  • Task still in agent.HostedQueue (not yet taken by TsTaskGetAvailableAll or TsTaskGetAvailableTasks) — removed from the queue and finalized as canceled: Completed=true, MessageType=MESSAGE_ERROR, Message="Task canceled", FinishDate=now; OnComplete runs. Sync tasks are updated in the DB and broadcast as a task update; others are removed from the client.
  • Task already dispatched (in agent.RunningTasks) is cancelable too: removed from RunningTasks, TsFrameResetDownstream drops the rest of that downstream session, server AxScript hooks for that task are unregistered, then the same finalization.

Frame Manager Functions

Frame Manager is shared infrastructure for protocol-independent fragmentation/reassembly of large messages between server and agent. It extracts the duplicated logic from listener plugins. It supports three upstream-assembly modes, auto-detected from the first call to the corresponding method:

  • Byte-offset mode (TsFramePut with totalSize > 0, chunkCount == 0): the caller knows the total size in bytes and addresses by byte offset.
  • Chunk-index mode (TsFramePut with chunkCount > 0): the caller knows the chunk count and addresses by chunk index.
  • Stream mode (TsFramePutStream): the total size is unknown up front; chunks arrive with an incrementing seqNum, and the isLast flag signals completion.

Encoding/decoding (compression, frame headers) is performed by the plugin. The plugin passes an encode callback to TsFrameGetChunk and decodes the data returned by TsFramePut/TsFramePutStream itself.

TsFrameHasPending

Returns true if the agent has outgoing data in its downstream session, tasks in HostedQueue, pivot tasks for child agents, or orphaned TASK/BROWSER tasks in RunningTasks (see the requeue above).

TsFrameHasPending(sessionId int64) bool

TsFramePut

Accepts an upstream fragment from the listener and places it into the reassembly buffer. When assembly is complete, returns the assembled raw block (the plugin decodes/decompresses it and calls TsAgentProcessData).

TsFramePut(sessionId int64, index uint32, data []byte, totalSize uint32, chunkCount uint16) (complete bool, nextExpected uint32, received uint32, sackBitmap uint32, assembled []byte)
ParameterTypeDescription
sessionIdstringSession ID (usually agentId)
indexuint32Byte offset or chunk index (depends on the mode)
data[]byteFragment contents
totalSizeuint32Full message size (byte-offset mode); 0 for chunk-index mode
chunkCountuint16Number of chunks (chunk-index mode); 0 for byte-offset mode

Returns: complete — fully assembled; nextExpected — next expected offset/index; received — how much has been received; sackBitmap — SACK bitmap of acknowledged chunks; assembled — the fully assembled blob (only when complete=true).

TsFramePutStream

Accepts an upstream chunk in stream mode. Chunks arrive with an increasing seqNum; out-of-order arrivals are buffered. When a chunk with isLast = true arrives and all preceding seqNums have been collected — the function returns the assembled raw block.

TsFramePutStream(sessionId int64, seqNum uint32, data []byte, isLast bool) (complete bool, assembled []byte)
ParameterTypeDescription
sessionIdint64Session ID (usually agentId)
seqNumuint32Chunk sequence number (starting at 0)
data[]byteChunk contents
isLastbooltrue — this chunk is the last

Returns: complete — the stream is fully assembled; assembled — the assembled data (only when complete=true). Duplicate seqNums are ignored; a repeated TsFramePutStream for an already-finished session returns (true, nil).

TsFramePutDecoded

A TsFramePut variant (byte-offset mode): after the reassembly completes, the decode callback is applied to the assembled block. If decoding returns an error — assembled = nil (the listener can drop the session instead of dispatching garbage).

TsFramePutDecoded(sessionId int64, index uint32, data []byte, totalSize uint32, chunkCount uint16, decode func(assembled []byte) ([]byte, error)) (bool, uint32, uint32, uint32, []byte)

Returns: the same values as TsFramePut (complete, nextExpected, received, sackBitmap, assembled), but assembled is the result of decode(assembled).

TsFrameGetChunk

Returns the next downstream chunk for an agent. Creates a downstream session on the first call (including pulling tasks from HostedQueue, packing and encrypting by the agent, applying encode).

TsFrameGetChunk(sessionId int64, reqOffset uint32, maxChunkSize int, encode func([]byte) []byte) (total uint32, offset uint32, data []byte, taskNonce uint32, isEmpty bool)
ParameterTypeDescription
sessionIdstringSession ID
reqOffsetuint32Requested offset
maxChunkSizeintMax bytes in a chunk (transport-dependent, e.g., 160 for DNS UDP)
encodefunc([]byte) []byteOptional callback to prepare the full payload (compression + frame); nil — no transformation

Returns: total — total payload size, offset — actual chunk offset, data — chunk contents, taskNonce — session nonce (for subsequent ACK), isEmpty — no data to send.

TsFrameGetChunkSticky

The downstream session is marked sticky: when maxAttempts is exceeded it is not evicted — the attempt counter resets instead, and the session is released only by the idle timeout or via TsFrameAckDelivery. The attempt counter is incremented only on repeated requests for the same offset — requesting a new offset resets it.

TsFrameGetChunkSticky(sessionId int64, reqOffset uint32, maxChunkSize int, encode func([]byte) []byte) (total uint32, offset uint32, data []byte, taskNonce uint32, isEmpty bool)

TsFrameAckDelivery

Acknowledges to the agent that the entire downstream message has been delivered. Releases the downstream session.

TsFrameAckDelivery(sessionId int64, ackOffset uint32, ackNonce uint32)

TsFrameTakeStatTasks / TsFrameTakeStatRecv

Atomically take the statistics accumulated by the Frame Manager for a session. Framed transports print "N bytes sent" after TsFrameGetChunk or TsFrameGetChunkSticky, or after a completed TsFramePut, TsFramePutDecoded, or TsFramePutStream.

TsFrameTakeStatTasks(sessionId int64) (StatTasks, int, bool)
TsFrameTakeStatRecv(sessionId int64) (size int, requests int, ok bool)

TsFrameResetUpstream / TsFrameResetDownstream

Reset an unfinished upstream or downstream session (e.g., when desync is detected or an agent is explicitly reloaded).

TsFrameResetUpstream(sessionId int64)
TsFrameResetDownstream(sessionId int64)

Used on task/upload cancellation: resetting the downstream session prevents the agent from receiving the canceled task's tail on its next poll.

Client GUI Functions

Functions for synchronizing data with GUI clients (File Browser, Process Manager). These functions send results only to the client that initiated the request.

TsClientGuiDisksWindows

Sends the list of Windows drives to the client.

TsClientGuiDisksWindows(taskData adaptix.TaskData, drives []adaptix.ListingDrivesDataWin)
ParameterTypeDescription
taskDataadaptix.TaskDataTask data
drives[]adaptix.ListingDrivesDataWinDrive list

TsClientGuiFilesWindows

Sends the list of Windows files to the client.

TsClientGuiFilesWindows(taskData adaptix.TaskData, path string, files []adaptix.ListingFileDataWin)
ParameterTypeDescription
taskDataadaptix.TaskDataTask data
pathstringDirectory path
files[]adaptix.ListingFileDataWinFile list

TsClientGuiFilesUnix

Sends the list of Unix/Linux files to the client.

TsClientGuiFilesUnix(taskData adaptix.TaskData, path string, files []adaptix.ListingFileDataUnix)
ParameterTypeDescription
taskDataadaptix.TaskDataTask data
pathstringDirectory path
files[]adaptix.ListingFileDataUnixFile list

TsClientGuiFilesStatus

Sends the file operation status (delete, rename, etc.) to the client.

TsClientGuiFilesStatus(taskData adaptix.TaskData)
ParameterTypeDescription
taskDataadaptix.TaskDataTask data with MessageType and Message for status

TsClientGuiProcessWindows

Sends the list of Windows processes to the client.

TsClientGuiProcessWindows(taskData adaptix.TaskData, process []adaptix.ListingProcessDataWin)
ParameterTypeDescription
taskDataadaptix.TaskDataTask data
process[]adaptix.ListingProcessDataWinProcess list

TsClientGuiProcessUnix

Sends the list of Unix/Linux processes to the client.

TsClientGuiProcessUnix(taskData adaptix.TaskData, process []adaptix.ListingProcessDataUnix)
ParameterTypeDescription
taskDataadaptix.TaskDataTask data
process[]adaptix.ListingProcessDataUnixProcess list

Credentials Functions

TsCredentilsAdd

Adds credentials.

TsCredentilsAdd(creds []map[string]interface{}) error

Credential structure:

map[string]interface{}{
    "username": "admin",
    "password": "hash_or_password",
    "realm":    "DOMAIN",
    "type":     "NTLM",
    "tag":      "DC01",
    "storage":  "LSASS",
    "agent_id": "abc123",
    "host":     "192.168.1.1",
}

Events:

  • credentials.add (Pre/Post hooks)

TsCredentilsEdit

TsCredentilsEdit(credId int64, username string, password string, realm string, credType string, tag string, storage string, host string) error

Events:

  • credentials.edit (Pre/Post hooks)

TsCredentialsSetTag

TsCredentialsSetTag(credsId []int64, tag string) error

TsCredentilsDelete

TsCredentilsDelete(credsId []int64) error

Events:

  • credentials.remove (Pre/Post hooks)

Download/Upload Functions

TsDownloadAdd

Initializes a file download. fileId comes from TsFileGenID.

TsDownloadAdd(agentId int64, fileId int64, fileName string, fileSize int64) error

Events:

  • download.start (Pre/Post hooks)

TsDownloadUpdate

Updates download state.

TsDownloadUpdate(fileId int64, state int, data []byte) error
StateValueDescription
1RUNNINGDownload in progress
2STOPPEDPaused
3FINISHEDCompleted
4CANCELEDCancelled

TsDownloadClose

Finishes a download.

TsDownloadClose(fileId int64, reason int) error

Events:

  • download.finish (Pre/Post hooks)

TsDownloadSave

Saves a file directly (from memory).

TsDownloadSave(agentId int64, fileId int64, filename string, content []byte) error

TsDownloadGet

One transfer record. The in-memory map is checked first; otherwise the DB row is returned. Unknown id is "File not found: <id>". No event.

TsDownloadGet(fileId int64) (TransferData, error)

TsDownloadGetFilepath

Returns the local path to the downloaded file.

TsDownloadGetFilepath(fileId int64) (string, error)

Returns: Full path to the file on the server.

Note: Works only for completed downloads (state=FINISHED).

TsDownloadDelete

Deletes downloaded files.

TsDownloadDelete(fileId []int64) error

Events:

  • download.remove (Pre/Post hooks)

TsDownloadSetTag

Update of a tag on a group of downloads.

TsDownloadSetTag(fileIds []int64, tag string) error
ParameterTypeDescription
fileIds[]int64Array of download FileIds
tagstringNew tag; empty string clears it

TsUploadAdd / TsUploadAddContent

Initialize an upload of a file to an agent. TsUploadAdd reads the file from disk (localPath). TsUploadAddContent takes bytes in memory and optional memory-artifact fields. fileId comes from TsFileGenID.

TsUploadAdd(agentId int64, fileId int64, localPath string, remotePath string) error
TsUploadAddContent(agentId int64, fileId int64, remotePath string, content []byte, canceled bool, kind int, artname string, arttype string) error
ParameterTypeDescription
canceledboolfalse → TsUploadClose(CANCELED) rejects with an error; the UI Cancel button is disabled. For artifacts without an agent-side break command. Regular file uploads — true.
kindintTRANSFER_KIND_FILE = 0 (regular file) or TRANSFER_KIND_MEMORY = 1 (BOF / shellcode / .NET)
artnamestringOperator-friendly label for Kind=MEMORY (BOF / shellcode name). For FILE — empty string.
arttypestringCategory for Kind=MEMORY ("bof" / "shellcode" / "dotnet"). For FILE — empty string.

Events: upload.start (Pre/Post hooks).

TsUploadGetChunk

Returns the next chunk of the upload file. Used by the agent plugin when preparing a portion of data to send to the agent.

TsUploadGetChunk(fileId int64, chunkSize int, needApprove bool) ([]byte, error)
ParameterTypeDescription
fileIdint64Upload session ID
chunkSizeintDesired chunk size (bytes)
needApprovebooltrue — Progress is incremented only after TsUploadApprove; false — immediately

Returns: a slice of the read bytes; nil with no error means the file has already been fully sent.

TsUploadApprove

Acknowledges delivery of the next chunk of upload data to the agent. Used when needApprove = true, where the agent explicitly confirms receipt of a chunk before Progress is incremented.

TsUploadApprove(fileId int64, approvedBytes int) error

TsUploadClose

Closes the upload session (reason — TRANSFER_STATE_FINISHED or TRANSFER_STATE_CANCELED).

TsUploadClose(fileId int64, reason int) error

If reason == TRANSFER_STATE_CANCELED and the upload has Cancellable == false (memory artifact without an agent-side break) — returns upload %d is not cancellable. TsAgentRemove and TsUploadDelete still close that upload. After a successful close, state and progress are saved.

Events: upload.finish (Pre/Post hooks).

TsUploadGet

Returns the current snapshot of an upload session. The in-memory map is checked first; otherwise the stored row is returned (finished or canceled). Same shape as TsDownloadGet.

TsUploadGet(fileId int64) (adaptix.TransferData, error)

TsUploadDelete

Cancel and remove uploads. Active records are closed as canceled even when Cancellable is false, then the ids are deleted. Clients receive a transfer-delete for each upload. Backs POST /upload/delete.

TsUploadDelete(fileIds []int64) error

Listener Functions

TsListenerGet

Returns the data of a running listener.

TsListenerGet(listenerName string) (adaptix.ListenerData, bool)

Parameters:

  • listenerName — listener instance name.

Returns: the ListenerData and an existence flag (false — listener not found; an empty name returns false immediately).

TsListenerGetProfile

Gets a profile for agent generation.

TsListenerGetProfile(listenerName string) (string, []byte, error)

Returns: watermark, profile bytes, error

TsListenerInteralHandler

Handles internal requests (pivot agents).

TsListenerInteralHandler(watermark string, data []byte) (int64, error)

Returns: child agent id (int64) and an error.

TsListenerList / TsListenerCatalog

Running listeners, and the listener types registered by extenders.

TsListenerList() (string, error)
TsListenerCatalog() (string, error)

TsPivotCreate(pivotId string, pAgentId int64, chAgentId int64, pivotName string, isRestore bool) error

TsPivotDelete

TsPivotDelete(pivotId string) error

Screenshot Functions

TsScreenshotAdd

Adds a screenshot.

TsScreenshotAdd(agentId int64, Note string, Content []byte) error

Events:

  • screenshot.add (Pre/Post hooks)

TsScreenshotNote

Updates the note for a screenshot.

TsScreenshotNote(screenId int64, note string) error

TsScreenshotDelete

Deletes a screenshot.

TsScreenshotDelete(screenId int64) error

Target Functions

TsTargetsAdd

Adds new targets (hosts). Duplicates are automatically ignored.

TsTargetsAdd(targets []map[string]interface{}) error

Target structure:

map[string]interface{}{
    "computer": "DC01",           // Computer name
    "domain":   "CORP.LOCAL",     // Domain
    "address":  "192.168.1.10",   // IP address
    "os":       1,                // 1=Windows, 2=Linux, 3=macOS
    "os_desk":  "Windows Server 2019",
    "tag":      "Domain Controller",
    "info":     "Additional information",
    "alive":    true,             // Is target alive
}

Events:

  • target.add (Pre/Post hooks)

TsTargetsEdit

Edits an existing target.

TsTargetsEdit(targetId int64, computer string, domain string, address string, os int, osDesk string, tag string, info string, alive bool) error
ParameterTypeDescription
targetIdint64Target ID
computerstringComputer name
domainstringDomain
addressstringIP address
osintOS type (1/2/3)
osDeskstringOS description
tagstringTag
infostringAdditional info
aliveboolIs alive

Events:

  • target.edit (Pre/Post hooks)

TsTargetSetTag

Sets a tag for a group of targets.

TsTargetSetTag(targetsId []int64, tag string) error

TsTargetDelete

Deletes targets.

TsTargetDelete(targetsId []int64) error

Events:

  • target.remove (Pre/Post hooks)

Tunnel Functions

TsTunnelStart

Starts the created tunnel.

TsTunnelStart(TunnelId int64) (int64, error)

Returns: TaskId for tracking

Events:

  • tunnel.start (Pre/Post hooks)

TsTunnelCreate* Functions

Functions for creating tunnels of different types. Return TunnelId.

Creates a SOCKS4 proxy.

TsTunnelCreateSocks4(AgentId int64, Info string, Lhost string, Lport int) (int64, error)

TsTunnelCreateRportfwd(AgentId int64, Info string, Lport int, Thost string, Tport int) (int64, error)

LportintPort on agent

Logging Functions

Functions for emitting entries to the centralized LogManager. Entries are kept in a 5000-element RAM ring buffer (oldest are evicted), printed to stdout (status Debug only if the server runs with --debug), and batch-broadcast to every subscribed client every 50 ms / 100 entries via the WebSocket.

The Source field is conventionally prefixed by owner type so the client can filter by source:

Prefix Owner
server:<file> built-in server code
listener:<name> listener plugins
agent:<id> per-agent activity
axscript:<file> user-supplied AxScript
service:<name> service plugins

Level is the nesting depth (0 = top-level); the client renders deeper levels with extra indentation.

TsLogAdd

Emits one entry to the LogManager.

TsLogAdd(status adaptix.LogStatus, level int, source, category string, format string, args ...any)
Parameter Type Description
status adaptix.LogStatus LogStatusDebug(0) / LogStatusInfo(1) / LogStatusSuccess(2) / LogStatusWarn(3) / LogStatusError(4)
level int Nesting depth
source string Source. If category is empty and source contains :, the part before the first colon becomes the source and the rest becomes the category
category string Category. Empty lets the manager split it out of source
format string fmt.Sprintf format
args ...any Format arguments

TsLogWriter

Returns an io.Writer adapter that marshals each line written to it as a separate LogEntry.

TsLogWriter(status adaptix.LogStatus, source, category string) io.Writer
Parameter Type Description
status adaptix.LogStatus Severity for every entry
source string Source tag for every entry
category string Category for every entry. Empty is allowed

Typical use inside a listener plugin:

import (
    "log"
    adaptix "github.com/Adaptix-Framework/axc2/v2"
)

server := &http.Server{
    Addr:     fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", t.Config.HostBind, t.Config.PortBind),
    Handler:  router,
    ErrorLog: log.New(Ts.TsLogWriter(adaptix.LogStatusWarn, logSrc, ""), "", 0),
}

type TaskData struct {

    TaskId      int64    // Unique task ID

    StartDate   int64    // Start time
    FinishDate  int64    // Finish time
    Data        []byte   // Binary task data
    CommandLine string   // Command line
    MessageType int      // Message type: INFO=5, ERROR=6, SUCCESS=7
    Message     string   // Message header
    ClearText   string   // Message text
    Completed   bool     // Completion flag
    Priority    uint     // Priority of the task in HostedQueue (higher = earlier)
    Sync        bool     // Sync to the GUI

    // OnDispatch runs after the task is taken from HostedQueue and before PackTasks. Not serialized — lost on server restart.
    OnDispatch     func(ts any, task *TaskData) `json:"-" msgpack:"-"`

    // OnComplete fires once when Completed becomes true: on the agent result (TsTaskUpdate) or immediately when OnDispatch itself sets Completed.
    OnComplete     func(ts any, task *TaskData) `json:"-" msgpack:"-"`

    // Repeat puts the task back on HostedQueue after a dispatch while Completed is false.
    Repeat         bool                         `json:"-" msgpack:"-"`

    // DispatchBudget is how many bytes OnDispatch may still put in task.Data for this poll. 0 means unknown.
    DispatchBudget int                          `json:"-" msgpack:"-"`
}
